name: WizeStream Desktop 0.6.0 Beta — Unsigned
body:
> [!WARNING]
> This is an explicitly unsigned beta for testing. It is not a signed public release.

Windows will show an unknown-publisher or SmartScreen warning. macOS Gatekeeper may block the app unless the tester deliberately allows it. Only install this beta if you understand and accept those warnings.

Production automatic updates are disabled in these builds, and updater metadata is intentionally not published. Install future betas manually.

Included platforms:
- Windows x64 installer and portable executable
- Windows ARM64 installer and portable executable
- macOS Intel and Apple Silicon DMG/ZIP
- Linux x64 and arm64 AppImage/DEB

Verify downloads with `SHA256SUMS` and the attached GitHub artifact attestations.
Corresponding GPL source: https://github.com/wizdom13/WizeStream-Desktop/tree/246113286469379ae763b055b6b01798a8e03d21
